Absolute Bikes Sedona Shop Rides

Sedona, AZ · Village of Oak Creek · Mountain bike

About the Absolute Bikes Sedona Shop Rides group ride

Employee-led trail rides straight from the Village of Oak Creek shop. Length and difficulty change week to week. Runs in the cooler months only. Bring water, snacks and a repair kit.
